# Comfy Luma Ray 3.2- Text to Video

Generate cinematic-quality videos from text prompts using Luma Ray 3.2, with optional video extension by providing a generation ID from a previous run. Ideal for creating short film sequences, marketing content, and iterative video refinement. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_luma_ray3_3_t2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Cinematic tracking shot of a fierce young woman in battle-worn chrome armor riding a massive white tiger with glowing blue neural stripes, galloping across a scorched futuristic battlefield, shattered mechs and burning wreckage behind them, dust and embers in the air, heroic and defiant, epic sci-fi fantasy, golden hour light, 4K, shallow depth of field
